note: Photos the owner hides (read by scripts/launch.mjs). Every launched cat's card shows the photo from its X post, credited "Photo: @handle on X" with a link to the post, and the post's photo is its coin's picture. List a post's X status id here (in quotes) to hide its photo: the next Launch run moves the cat's data/real-photos.json entry, whole, to "hidden" (the card shows its portrait) and a coin not sent yet takes the site's own picture (assets/og-image.jpg) instead. A launched coin's picture cannot change: hide a photo before its launch if the coin must not show it. Remove the id to show the photo again: it comes back from "hidden" exactly as it was. A file that is not JSON, or not { "hide": [ids] }, hides nothing (the Launch run warns).
